key_path: Run `npx @datadog/ai-setup-cli --site datadoghq.com`: it opens the browser for account creation or OAuth (docs: 'for account creation if you don't have an account yet'). Alternative: the web trial form
Trial form: business email, choose a region/site (irreversible), password, name, job title, company; phone is optional; no card; 14-day trial
Grant OAuth consent, after which the CLI or MCP holds a scoped token
For static creds: Organization Settings > API Keys and Application Keys (or PAT/SAT); `pup auth login` does OAuth2+PKCE in the browser
human_gates: business_email_required (personal domains rejected on the trial form)

agent_native_auth.cli_browser_or_device_login: yes: `pup auth login` (OAuth2+PKCE, browser); `@datadog/ai-setup-cli` uses browser OAuth with a localhost callback, or DD_API_KEY/DD_APP_KEY when headless
agent_native_auth.oauth_dcr_for_mcp: yes: remote MCP authenticates with OAuth 2.0 inside the client (org admins manage MCP OAuth redirect URLs under organization-settings/mcp)
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mints_keys: yes: API/app keys, PATs and service accounts can be created via API by an authenticated user (pup covers 'Users, API keys, application keys, organizations')
agent_native_auth.scoped_keys: yes: scoped application keys, Personal Access Tokens, Service Access Tokens; MCP toolsets via ?toolsets= query
agent_native_auth.free_tier: 14-day full trial, no card; limited free tier afterwards

product_mcp_remote.url: site-specific endpoint shown by the docs site selector (the .md shows the placeholder <YOUR_MCP_SERVER_ENDPOINT>), e.g. ?toolsets=onboarding
product_mcp_remote.auth: OAuth (preferred), or PAT/SAT bearer header, or DD_API_KEY+DD_APP_KEY headers

mcp.local: separate local-only Code Security MCP (SAST/SCA/secrets); the main MCP is remote-only
mcp.docs_mcp: no separate docs MCP; onboarding toolset instruments apps
mcp.one_click: Cursor install deeplink per site; Cursor/Codex/Grok plugins; Claude directory connector; ChatGPT app (Preview, US1 only)

docs_for_agents.md_pages: yes, .md for every page, including 'Note for AI agents' blocks
docs_for_agents.openapi: public in the DataDog/datadog-api-client-* repos (not re-fetched)
docs_for_agents.agent_skills: pup ships embedded skills (`pup skills install`)

score_justification: Strong OAuth everywhere (CLI, MCP, setup CLI) and a CLI that can start account creation. Business-email-only signup, region choice and site-specific URLs add friction.
best_practice: The headless setup CLI falls back cleanly: browser OAuth when interactive, DD_API_KEY/DD_APP_KEY env vars when unattended. MCP toolsets can be selected by query param.
biggest_gap: Region/site fragmentation: every URL depends on the site, and the .md docs render placeholders instead of real endpoints. Personal emails are blocked.
notes: ChatGPT app and Codex plugin are Preview and US1-only.
